nodes.text: If it makes you feel any better, you're the best date a guy could ask for.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: You know, that `does` help a little.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, that [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] help a little.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, you know what? Maybe you should try playing. There's still another level...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know... I've never played before...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Just remember, the guys in purple are neutral, the ones in red are our allies, and the ones in black are the enemies.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And the guys in yellow are civilians. Don't shoot them either!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh... Okay!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Come on, you can do it! Just give it a try!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh, man... Your girl better not slow us down!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Gulp...
The game begins...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I've got to shoot the guys in...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. You heard the lady.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Aw, this sucks.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Come on, Peter. Let's get out of here.
You take Peter's hand and pull him out to the deserted back yard.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: This is better.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah, nice and romantic out here, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah...
Peter tilts your head up and leans in to kiss you...
Suddenly, you hear shouting coming from inside the house...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Use the plasma rifle!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Incoming! Incoming! The swarm is about to hit us.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yes! We got 'em! Woo!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Oh... Sounds like they just won.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: You don't... Mind missing out on the game, do you?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: No! Of course not! I mean, I'd rather be with you. Too bad you can't be two places at once, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah.
Peter takes your hand and pulls you close.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: But since I have to choose, of course I'd rather be out here with you. Don't be silly. You're way more important to me than any game.
You and Peter finish eating as the sun finishes setting.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Okay, it's getting late. We should get back.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I mean, I'm your best friend. I know you better than anyone else... So I know what a great guy you are.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: How could I resist having feelings for you?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Then why didn't you ever say something?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: For the same reason that you didn't! I couldn't tell how you felt!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I mean, whenever we used to spend time together, I'd be wondering what it meant to you... If you wanted something more, or if you just wanted to be friends.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Well, when you put it that way, it makes sense.
Peter puts his arm around you and pulls you close to him.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad I finally asked you to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Really? Not even once?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I mean, maybe it crossed my mind once or twice lately, but you were always like a brother to me.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Oh... That's... Um... Kind of `really` creepy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... That's... Um... Kind of [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] creepy.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I mean, it's not like that now! Now it's different! Really different!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Uh, right.
Peter spreads a blanket on the ground and pulls out a picnic basket.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: So what's for dinner?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Well, not to brag, but I thought of everything. Strawberries, sandwiches, and chocolate cookies for dessert!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Looks delicious!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Here, have some lemonade to start with.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter, you really put a lot of thought into today.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Of course. I really like you, $Kelly. I want this date to be perfect.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I mean, when I think about it, I guess I've always sort of had feelings for you... But I thought I was totally in the friend zone!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: So I tried to be happy with that. But now that I have a chance with you... I'm going to do everything I can to sweep you off your feet.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Aww... That's so sweet.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Come on, what about you? Did you ever have feelings for me before I asked you out?

nodes.prompt: Did you ever have feelings for me before I asked you out?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Did you ever have feelings for me before I asked you out?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Feeling adventurous, huh? Okay, let's try it.
Peter takes your hand and the two of you step off the path and walk through the woods.
You keep walking as the sun begins to set...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I hope you know where we're going.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, trust me.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm just saying, we've been walking for almost twenty minutes, and...
The two of you step out of the forrest and into a beautiful clearing full of wild flowers!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah? You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: That you're amazing!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter, this is...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: The perfect place for a picnic? I know.
You and Peter follow the trail until you hear the sounds of falling water...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: There it is! The waterfall! It's beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: We made it here so quickly, why don't we go dip our feet in the water before we eat?
You and Peter go down to the edge of the water and take your shoes off. The two of you dip your feet in the cold, clear water.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh! It's so cold!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Heh, I'll keep you warm.
Peter wraps his arms around you.
As the two of you enjoy the view, the sun begins to set.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter, look at that sunset! It's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: It's really nice being here with you, $Kelly. Well, should we have our picnic?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Definitely! I can't wait to see what you brought!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: It's beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, how about we take a walk around before we eat?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sure! Where should we go?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Well, according to the trail signs up here, there are a few different paths we could take.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I think there's a really beautiful hike that leads to a waterfall.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Or, if you're looking for something a little more exciting, we can go off-trail...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: If you want to see more wildflowers, I heard about this awesome little meadow `full` of flowers that's around here somewhere!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you want to see more wildflowers, I heard about this awesome little meadow [color=#e23b3b][i]full[/i][/color] of flowers that's around here somewhere!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Let's go...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Those are poppies. Cheerful and bright... Just like you.
Peter picks one of the flowers and hands it to you.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: That's a snapdragon. Cute but tough... Just like you.
Peter picks one of the flowers and hands it to you.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Those are Calypso orchids. Some people call them 'fairy slippers'.
Peter picks one of the flowers and hands it to you.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Heh. Leave it to you to pick out the most whimsical and romantic flower out here.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Those are 'forget-me-nots'.
Peter picks one of the flowers and hands it to you.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Here, keep one. That way you'll never forget this date.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay, this is the real test. If this is a date, Peter will try to put his arm around me when the movie starts...
Soon enough, the movie starts! You watch the actors on the screen...
You discretely don't say anything, and...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Here you go! Eighteen dollars!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Thanks!
Peter smiles and leans over, taking your hand in his.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Let's head on in!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I've got it!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: No, no, let me!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: No, seriously, I, uh, I've got it...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: But I... I should... Don't you want me to...?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I just thought that... I mean... This isn't... Is it?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Hey! Are you two going to stand around being super awkward, or is one of you going to buy these tickets?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh! Um... Sorry...
You and Peter both pay and then awkwardly walk into the movie...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Huh? Wait for what?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I... Uh... I mean... Is this... You know... Never mind! Forget it! Just pay!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Okay... I guess...
Peter pays, and the two of you awkwarldy walk in.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That'll be eighteen dollars.
Peter glances at you. There is a sudden, awkward silence.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Is... Is he going to pay for me? Should I pay for myself? What's the protocol here?!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hmm... I've heard 'The Last Lover 3: A New Love' is pretty good. Some of the cheerleaders were talking about it...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sure! That sounds good!
The two of you walk up to the counter.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Two tickets for 'Last Lover', please!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: A bold choice! How about 'Deathless: The Mr. Doom Saga'? I hear it's based on a true story!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm game if you are!
The two of you walk up to the counter.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Two tickets for 'Deathless', please!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, do you remember when we were little, whenever we'd come down here, we'd compete to see who could gather the most shells in a minute?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'd always kick your butt at it.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: What? No, you didn't! I always won the shell game?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Well, there's only one way to settle this...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: You sure you're ready for this? Okay... Go!
You sprint all around the beach, grabbing up every shell you can find!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Ha! Minute's up! How many you got?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: 23! Beat that!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, wow, 23? That's amazing! That's so many shells!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: ...But it's not `28!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But it's not [color=#3b78e2][i]28![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: You're kidding me? No way! 28?! That's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Count 'em and weep!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I guess I could do that... Or I could just cheat!
Peter runs over and tackles you! The two of you go rolling in the sand!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: See? Now you don't have any shells!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: You're a total cheater! No fair!
You run around, grabbing every shell you can find when...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Whoa! Check out this prickly black one!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Uh, $Kelly? I don't think that's a shell...
You look down in your hand... And realize it's a sea urchin! You scramble to throw it away!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: `Ow!` It pricked me! That really hurt!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color] It pricked me! That really hurt!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Wait a minute? A sea urchin? Those things are crazy poisonous!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh no! I think you're right! It really hurts!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Quick! Let me suck the venom out!
Peter grabs your hand and starts frantically sucking at your palm!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Zach?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I came to show you this awesome rock that Jacob found... But now I'm totally weirded out!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: It's not what it looks like! Well, I don't really know what it looks like, but it's not that!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I got pricked by a sea urchin, and Peter is trying to suck the poison out!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sea urchins aren't poisonous...
Later that night, at your doorstep...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly, thanks for coming out tonight. I'm sorry about that whole thing with the sea urchin...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, it's okay. At least we learned a valuable lesson in marine biology, right?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly, thanks for coming out tonight. I had a really good time.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: And listen, I really appreciated you hanging out with me.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sorry Taylor went all Psycho Princess on you.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: She doesn't bother me... I'm just sorry you had to miss the party.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Those guys are all right, but... You're the one I wanted to spend time with.
Peter leans in and hugs you. You press your head against his chest... Look up into his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter is `really` cute... I wonder... Was this really a date? Or is he just putting up with me because I'm his friend?
nodes.text_bbcode: Peter is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] cute... I wonder... Was this really a date? Or is he just putting up with me because I'm his friend?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Well, good night, $Kelly.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Good night, Peter.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: See you around.
You call Peter up...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly? You doing anything tonight? I was thinking we could go catch a movie...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: A movie... Just the two of us? Could this be... A date?
You head down to the mall where you meet up with Peter.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly! Over here!
You head over to Peter, where he greets you with a close hug.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: So! What do you want to watch?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hmm... Let's go see...
You slip off your shoes and take Peter's hand as you step into the water.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Wow, a long romantic walk on a beach... Did you ever think we'd end up in this situation?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, uh, haha! I guess it's pretty funny. Who would have thought...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm good here.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Oh, really? Scared of a little water?
Peter splashes some water at you!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Heh. Sorry, I couldn't resist.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter, you... You don't have to do this for me.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: No, $Kelly, I do. `You're` the person I wanted to hang out with tonight, not them!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, $Kelly, I do. [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] the person I wanted to hang out with tonight, not them!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Besides, I've been hanging out with those football guys all week. They're not exactly the most stimulating company...
From down the beach, you can hear voices...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: This rock looks like a butt!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `Awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Peter slips off his shoes and wades into the waves up to his ankles.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: The water's nice. Here, come on out.
Peter holds out his hand to you.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey! I don't care if you're the head cheerleader or the Queen of England, you can't talk to me that way!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Uh, $Kelly, you might want to cool down...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm not going to cool down! I've got just as much of a right to be here as anyone! It's not like this is `your` beach!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to cool down! I've got just as much of a right to be here as anyone! It's not like this is [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] beach!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Actually, $Kelly... It kind of is.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: My family owns this stretch of the beach, loser. And if you were anyone worth hanging out with, you'd know that!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I... I mean... I...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You mean you were just leaving.
Maria turns and storms off. Peter turns to you and takes your hand. The two of you turn and start walking away from the party.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Okay, I am `so` sorry! I had no idea she'd react like that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry! I had no idea she'd react like that!

nodes.text: After you walk for a while, Peter settles down on a sand dune, and you sit down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Forget her. Who needs them? You and I can just hang out together.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Look, I didn't realize your guest rules were that strict, okay? But come on. She's my best friend. She's cool.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't care how cool she is! You don't get to bring some random nobody to my party!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah, you know what, I guess you're right. It was rude of me. Come on, $Kelly. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait, what? You can't leave! Everyone wanted to hang out with you!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah, well, either we both stay, or we both go. What's it gonna be?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, I... I mean, this is... Well, I...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Too late. Come on, $Kelly. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh!
You and Peter walk down the beach, then settle down on a sand dune.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Forget the party. Who needs them? You and I can just hang out together.
Later that night, you say goodbye to Peter on your doorstep...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, sorry again about my brother's prank... That was really not cool...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, it's no big deal. Besides, we got hazed by college kids! I think that makes us part of a frat or something!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Heh, yeah... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm sorry if tonight didn't go as well as you hoped... But I still had fun. Thanks for inviting me.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I had a really good time tonight, Peter. Thanks for inviting me.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: No problem! I had a good time, too... Even if I'm gonna slug Chuck the next time I see him.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Heh. Right.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay, here it is... The end of the date... If this is a date. Is Peter going to try to kiss me?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: See you at school, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh. Yeah. See you!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Maybe I was wrong about this being a date... Maybe Peter really does just see me as his friend...
You call up Peter...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey, Peter! You doing anything tonight?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Actually, I'm going down to the beach... I guess some of the cool kids were going to hang out there.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Wanna come?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sure!
You show up to the beach at sunset where a small crowd of cheerleaders and football players are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly! You look great tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Thanks! And thanks for inviting me here, I...
Suddenly, a cheerleader runs up and rudely shoves you two aside.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa! What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This party is for football players and cheerleaders only!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're not a cheerleader, and unless there's something I missed, I'm pretty sure you're not on the football team!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: She's with me, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't care who she's with! She wasn't invited!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What do I do?
You give Peter a big hug... And the crowd starts booing!
Peter pulls away from you.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Aw, I think the crowd wanted to see a nice, romantic kiss!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well. Um. I've got to say, folks, this is the most awkward Kiss-Cam we've ever had that didn't involve the Governor!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: What's wrong, son? Don't you like your girl?
Suddenly, Peter leans down and kisses you!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: That's more like it!
The crowd cheers and the camera cuts away.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Wow. I... Wow.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Sorry about that. Had to think of a way to get the crowd off our back, right?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: That kiss was amazing... I wonder if Peter felt the same way...
You lean over and kiss Peter! He pulls you close!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Let's give it up for Peter and his new girlfriend!
The crowd cheers! You blush, and the Kiss-Cam cuts away.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh, hey. That was... Wow.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Thanks for playing along. I can't believe Chuck pulled a prank like that.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh. Right! Just playing along! Heh!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I really felt something when we kissed... But did Peter feel anything?
You freeze up! You and Peter just stare blankly at the camera! The crowd starts to boo!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Hey, I said this was the Kiss-Cam, not the Uncomfortably-Awkward-Cam! What's wrong with you two?

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Sorry I subjected you all to that, folks. Let's just get back to the game.
The camera cuts away.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Geez. That was pretty awkward, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I guess we're really bad at pretending to be a couple.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah... Guess so.
Out on the field, Chuck gets up.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Looks like McKenzie's going to be just fine, folks.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. You're right.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Another touchdown for Centerscore! The score is 13-0... It's gonna be a brutal game, folks!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Now, let's take a quick break from the game to shine the spotlight on an adorable couple! Folks, if I can direct your attention to the Kiss-Cam...
You look up at the big screen over the field as it fills up with hearts and flowers...
And then displays you and Peter!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: What the...?! This must be one of Chuck's pranks!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Yes, folks, that's Peter McKenzie, little brother of our very own superstar Chuck, out with his brand new girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Come on, you two lovebirds! Show us a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh man... Peter is really embarrassed... I've got to think fast!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I mean, what's the worst that could happen? It's just a football game.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: 'Just a football game'?! People get seriously injured in football games all the time!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Er... Right... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Heh, yeah, you're right. He'd never let me hear the end of it if he knew I was worried about him.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Thanks, $Kelly.
You show up at Centerscore University and look around...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey! $Kelly! You made it! I wasn't sure you'd come...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Of course I would! I love spending time with you!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Some of Chuck's frat brothers hooked me up with really nice seats, front and center. Let's go! Snacks are my treat!
You and Peter settle into your seats. The football game starts...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And Centersore takes the lead as Number 28, Chuck McKenzie scores the first touchdown!
A bunch of frat guys jump up and cheer!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Woo! Chuck! Way to go!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm definitely glad I didn't get involved...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Even if I `do` feel a little guilty.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] feel a little guilty.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Dominique
nodes.text: This is none of your business. Just walk away.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'm `making it` my business.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]making it[/i][/color] my business.

nodes.speaker: Dominique
nodes.text: Whatever. This is getting boring. Let's get out of here, Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Totally.
The girls walk away.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You didn't have to do that. I can handle myself.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I just thought...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'd better go.
She walks away.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I guess that's what I get for trying to help... But at least I did the right thing.
Between classes...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's going on with those girls over there?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Nice dress, Emily. Too bad it doesn't actually `fit.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice dress, Emily. Too bad it doesn't actually [color=#e23b3b][i]fit.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ew. Did you see the face she just made? I think I'm going to have nightmares.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: It's probably none of my business... But maybe I should say something.
Your team jogs out onto the field...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sweetie! Hey, $Kelly!
You turn and see your parents waving to you from the stands.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Mom? Dad? What are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: We couldn't miss your big game!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Good luck, honey!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Some of the girls on this team are just here because they want to stick it to Wilson High... Or to get some P.E. credit!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh! I, uh, don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: So why do you play soccer, Jill?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I play for the purity of the sport, for the raw, athletic thrill! Racing down the field, dodging the defenders, nailing that one perfect goal...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: There's nothing like it!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I know what you mean! So who are we playing today?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: The Cleaverville Caterpillars. They've got a decent record, but I figure we've got a good shot against them. Let's do this!
You run out onto the field, and the game begins!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hee hee, I'm not a soccer player... I'm a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, right. The uniform. I should have figured that one out.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No problem. I guess Peter hasn't been very good about showing you the ropes, huh?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey, I've been doing my best.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sure. But guys are pretty clueless. I bet he didn't even tell you about the `Kiss and Make Up Dance.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure. But guys are pretty clueless. I bet he didn't even tell you about the [color=#3b78e2][i]Kiss and Make Up Dance.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See? He's totally useless. But don't worry... I'll fill you in!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: At the end of the Battle of the Schools, there's a big dance where we're all supposed to put our differences aside and have fun.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I knew about that! I was going to tell her about it later!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I just didn't think it was that important. I guess I thought $Kelly's not the type to get all worked up about a dance.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on. All girls are into dances. Aren't you excited about going to a dance, $Kelly?

nodes.prompt: Aren't you excited about going to a dance?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Aren't you excited about going to a dance?

nodes.text: Suddenly, there's some commotion from the Wilson side of the field! They're subbing a new player in...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Oh no... Is that...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Let's get this over with!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elliana?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Who's Elliana?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: A Brazillian foreign exchange student... She was at Centerscore High two years ago, and she's amazing at soccer!
The ref blows the whistle! Elliana immediately gets the ball, jets past your defense, and scores!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Amazing! That was one of the fastest goals I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I've got to score fast to make up for that!
You charge forward with the ball, but Elliana blocks your path.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Maybe if I distract her... I could try saying something in her native language to throw her off...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Do you have any classes with $Michael?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah, we've got science class together. It's pretty tough, though, we already had a quiz today!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh? How'd you do?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, lay off her! What kind of school makes a girl take a quiz on her first day? That's `balderdash!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, lay off her! What kind of school makes a girl take a quiz on her first day? That's [color=#e23b3b][i]balderdash![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Ooo, good word!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Thanks! It was in the crossword this morning!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I swear... Sometimes I don't know how I manage with you two!
On Wednesday afternoon, you meet up with Peter...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Hey, is it just me, or do we not have any class scheduled for this afternoon?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: You don't know about this? It's free study! You do know about free study, right?

nodes.prompt: You do know about free study, right?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You do know about free study, right?

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I was trying to be a good boyfriend... But the guys convinced me that I took it way too far.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: And now that I'm trying to be my own man, you're getting all worked up.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Look, maybe this whole thing was a bad idea. Maybe us dating is all a big mistake.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I mean, you can't even handle me going to a poker night!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I just don't like the way this is changing you! We had plans! I thought you'd want to see me...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: We see each other every day at school!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Fine! If you want to go so much, then just `go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! If you want to go so much, then just [color=#3b78e2][i]go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Peter turns and leaves, slamming the door behind him.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What a mess...
You're walking to your locker when you spot Peter with Zach and Jacob in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So I heard the Wilson High football team hasn't lost a game all season.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're really going to have to stay focused if we want to crush them.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Yeah... You guys are right.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Eep! Peter hasn't seen me yet! What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You see, one of the big events in the Battle of the Schools is an `Act-Off`... An acting showdown between us and the Wilson theater club!
nodes.text_bbcode: You see, one of the big events in the Battle of the Schools is an [color=#3b78e2][i]Act-Off[/i][/color]... An acting showdown between us and the Wilson theater club!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Everything's ready for our imminent victory... Except we don't have a set!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: You want me to build a set?!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Of course not, darling! I want you to convince the Auto-Shop crowd to do it!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I'd go myself, but for some reason, I just can't get along with those uncouth, oil-smelling, knuckle-draggers!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah... I can't imagine why...
A little while later, you find yourself in the Centerscore Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Well, I was kind of wondering... If maybe you guys wanted to, you know, help build the set for the big Act-Off...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And why would we possibly want to do that?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: If I'm going to sell this, I need to think like them! What kind of things would they like?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I don't know, I just had this weird feeling you guys would be into pyrotechnics, but I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, back up. Pyrotechnics? There are pyrotechnics involved?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, totally! They need this one big explosion at the end... Oh, and they'll need a bunch of swords forged...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Swords? Explosions? Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Me too!
You find Mona later that day...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well? Did you convince them?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Sort of... But I hope you're okay with the play having a bunch of explosions and sword fights...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well... It's a quiet, parochial comedy about a delicate English maiden on the cusp of her wedding...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: But yeah, we can work in some explosions and sword fights! Thanks, $Kelly!
Reputation Up

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: No problem!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Think how fun it would be! Building some sets... That'll be a nice change of pace from boring, old cars!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Boring... Old... Cars?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay, okay, wrong tactic. Don't you guys want to help your fellow students?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You mean those theater losers? Pffft, yeah, right!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I'll pay you ten dollars?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now you're just embarassing yourself.
Suddenly, a tall, wiry Auto-Shop guy steps out!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I'll help build the set!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Yeah... But there's something you gotta do for me...
You find Mona later that day...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well? Did you convince them?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Well, kind of... But I promised Trev he'd get a lead in the play!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh no, not Trev! That guy auditions every year, and never gets cast! He's a `terrible` actor!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no, not Trev! That guy auditions every year, and never gets cast! He's a [color=#3b78e2][i]terrible[/i][/color] actor!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: But I suppose beggars can't be choosers, darling. Thanks for your help... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Who's $Kelly again?
Suddenly, you hear the doorbell!
You run to the door and open it to find...

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: $Kelly... You look amazing.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Peter? What are you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Wait, before you say anything, I want you to know that I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: I was a total jerk to you before, but I want to make it up to you now.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Here's your corsage. What do you think?
Just then, a slow song comes on...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: All right, ladies and gentlemen! It's time for the first slow song of the night... And you know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Since this is the Kiss and Make Up Dance, every girl out there's got to grab a guy from your rival school and dance!
A girl reaches out and grabs Peter's arm...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Let's dance.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Uh... Sure. You better find someone from Wilson, $Kelly.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Right... But... Who?
Another slow slong comes on, and Peter takes you in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: How about a dance?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Oh, Peter...
The music slowly fades away...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, kids, that was the last song. Have a good night!

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Thanks for coming to the dance with me, $Kelly. I had a really great time.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Me too!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Thanks for dropping me off.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now, just let me snap a few pictures, and we'll let you go to your dance.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Cheese!
After the pictures, you head to the dance alone...
You turn to check out the punch on the back table and nearly run into Nicole!
Suddenly, a slow song starts playing...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: All right, ladies and gentlemen! It's time for the first slow song of the night... And you know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Since this is the Kiss and Make Up Dance, every girl out there's got to grab a guy from your rival school and dance!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Matteo? What...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And now, we've got a special dedication... From Matteo to $Kelly...
The first familiar notes of the song come on...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, kids, that was the last song. Have a good night!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is the happiest moment of my life... And it's all thanks to you, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Aww! It's been perfect.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $Kelly, I...
Matteo's cell phone buzzes.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hold on a second...
Matteo flips open his phone.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: `72 missed calls?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]72 missed calls?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Ugh... And I bet I know who they're from...
The song ends, and the two of you pull apart.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Well, thanks for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah. See you around.
The song ends and the two of you pull apart.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Well, thanks for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Yeah. See you around.
You wave to Darren and turn to find Peter.

nodes.speaker: Peter
nodes.text: Hey! Thought I'd never find you. Want to grab some punch?
Suddenly, Elliana approaches and lowers her shoulder, barreling right into you!
As you reach the Wilson goal, three defenders converge on you!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Time to take a shot!
You kick the ball...
...and score!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Woohoo! Go $Kelly!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: It's no time to celebrate yet... We've still got a lot of soccer left to play!
...and kick the ball out of bounds.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wipe that sad look off of your face and pay attention. The game's not over yet!
On the football field...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, Lizards! We can do this! Hold the line! Do `not` let them score a touchdown!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Lizards! We can do this! Hold the line! Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] let them score a touchdown!

nodes.text: The Wilson team hikes the ball... Their running back goes tearing down the field... Zach lunges to tackle him...
Meanwhile in the theater, the 'Act-Off' is taking place! Mona stands in front of a gorgeous set of a quaint little cottage....
Meanwhile, in the parking lot... A large crowd of nerds is gathered around for the Robot Deathmatch!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, come on... You can do this Boltar!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: Ha! There is no way your pathetic metal toy can defeat our Annihilatron!
The two robots circle each other on the field of battle...
And on the stage... The Battle of the Schools is having its Battle of the Bands!
Fifteen minutes later, it's half-time and the score is 4-2, Wilson. Your team regroups in the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is ridiculous! They can't just bring out some Brazillian soccer star and expect us to win against her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's no way we can win! We're going to let everyone down! Everyone!

nodes.text: That night, you sit at the dinner table with your family...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: So, $Kelly! How was your first day at school?
It's Friday, so you head to the locker room, where the rest of the girls on the soccer team are suiting up.
It's Friday, so you head to the locker room, where the rest of the girls are suiting up...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, new girl!
It's Friday, so you walk into the locker room... And find Kimi and Taylor furiously shouting at each other!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wilson has our playbooks, Taylor! Don't you realize what that means? It means we need to make new plays, stat!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Those were great plays, okay? I worked on them for weeks! So what if Wilson knows them? That doesn't mean they won't work!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Taylor, what you're talking about is suicide! We have to change our strategy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What, you just want to improvise? In one of the biggest games of the season?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's bad enough that I keep hearing all these rumors about Wilson having some kind of secret weapon... And now you're being insubordinate!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh oh! I need to step in... Fast!
It's Friday! Time for your first away soccer match!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Thanks so much for giving me a ride, Kimi! I really appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No problem. Just don't scuff up my leather seats, okay? This is a 1968 Anaconda! The finest object ever crafted by man!
Suddenly, there's a loud popping sound! The car screeches to the side of the road!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sounded like a popped tire!
An hour later, you and Kimi arrive at the game!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! You two! What's the big idea?!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Kimi popped a tire! We had to get a ride from a tow truck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, we don't have time to hash it out now! Without Kimi here, I had to sub Ashley in as goalie!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaah! The balls! They hit so `hard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaaaah! The balls! They hit so [color=#3b78e2][i]hard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What's the score?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 2-0, them!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Then I guess I'll just have to play even harder!
You strap on your cleats and jump into the game!
It's Friday, so you head to the locker room, where the rest of the girls are suiting up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hmm... Interesting. Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're going up against the Pittspoint Pittbulls, and rumor has it they've got some really strong strikers.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope Ashley can hold up against them... But if she can't, we'll need to really push our offense so we can keep up.
You jog out onto the field, and the game begins!
It's Friday, so you walk into the locker room... Where Taylor looks extremely upset!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Taylor? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's Jill! We're about to play our last game before the Battle of the Schools... And Jill's grounded!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Her parents found out that she's been ditching study hall all week to practice soccer, so they're not letting her play today!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The fact that her GPA is actually negative doesn't help...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: With Jill gone, we're not going to have much of an offense...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know. I know. Let's just go out there and do our best!
You walk out onto the soccer field...
Later that night, you head to the mall to meet Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey! $Kelly! There you are! You know $ZOE and Jill, right?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hmm... I don't think we've met. I'm Jill.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, $Kelly. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, blah blah blah, we all know each other.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Wait, hang on a second! Check out that Wilson High guy over there! He's totally staring at Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Eek! You're right! That's Brad, right? He's totally the star athelete at Wilson High, and amazingly gorgeous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't know about that. He doesn't look so amazing to me.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you `kidding?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#3b78e2][i]kidding?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay, $Kelly, tie-breaking vote. Is Brad totally hot or not?

nodes.prompt: Is Brad totally hot or not?

options.label: No way! He's not my type.
Come on, don't we have better things to do?

nodes.text: That night, you get a text from Nicole...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: '$Kelly, my life is over! Phil told me he's planning to ask out Kimi!'
And immediately after, a text from $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: 'We're at Nicole's house. Come quick. Bring ice cream.'

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like I'd better get to Nicole's place... Fast!
A few minutes later, at Nicole's house...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay! I'm here! I brought double chocolate chip ice cream and waffle cones!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $Kelly, no amount of waffle cones is going to make this better!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Ugh, she's been like this all night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What's wrong with me? Why don't guys like me? $Kelly, help me!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: You're being silly. Guys like you.

nodes.text: You're about to head home when Nicole comes running up to you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $Kelly! I need your help!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You've `got` to fill in for me on the cheerleading team today!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to fill in for me on the cheerleading team today!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The football team is playing tonight, and Maria will `kill` me if we're one short during the halftime show.
nodes.text_bbcode: The football team is playing tonight, and Maria will [color=#3b78e2][i]kill[/i][/color] me if we're one short during the halftime show.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Uh... But I don't know anything about cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Pleeease? You'll only have to do a little cheering. I'll owe you for life! I promise, I'll explain it later!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Great, thanks! Bye!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: That was weird... I wonder why Nicole couldn't make it to the football game tonight.
You head to the football field where you see the squad getting ready to perform for the halftime show. The stands are packed with cheering fans.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Um, hey, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay, ever since we caught Ryan trying to sneak on the field to make out with Nicole, there's a rule that spectators stay in the stands, freshman.

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Er... I'm here to help. Nicole said she couldn't make it, so she sent me to fill in for her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `What?!` Oh, Nicole is `so` dead. You don't even know the routine!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color] Oh, Nicole is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] dead. You don't even know the routine!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I bet $Kelly can pick it up. Just give her a chance.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Like we even have a choice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just remember. It's left foot, right foot, pom poms up, right, and then left!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: I... I think I can remember that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You better not mess this up, freshman! I `do not` want all of us looking like fools in front of the whole school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You better not mess this up, freshman! I [color=#3b78e2][i]do not[/i][/color] want all of us looking like fools in front of the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay, I've really got to step up and do this right...
The routine starts...

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Okay... Left foot, right foot... Pom poms up... And then... Uh...
At school the next day, the hallways are crowded!

Looks like Adrianna isn't going to give Matteo up without a fight! But at least $Kelly's on her way to having a great school year... Thanks to you.
And she and Matteo are off to a great start! But will they be able to keep their relationship together with Adrianna trying to break them up?
And just what was Adrianna trying to reach Matteo to tell him? You'll have to play the episodes to find out!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: This is... I can't believe it... It's 'Lady, I Love Your Love'!

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: What?! 'Crash Crash, Smash and Bash'? How'd you get them to play this at the dance?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I told him it was a desperate act of love.

nodes.text: Like something straight out of a fairy tale.

nodes.text: It's... You know... One of those territorial cat things...

nodes.text: You're one weird girl.

nodes.text: I thought you said your jerk boyfriend broke up with you.

nodes.text: Uh... That was my old jerk boyfriend. Now I'm with a new guy... And he's great.

nodes.text: So... Uh... How's Mitzy, Twinkles, Daisy, and the rest of the pack?

nodes.speaker: Kelly
nodes.text: Huh? Oh! Right! My seventeen cats.

nodes.text: Um, I mean, they're all doing great! I just love my cats! They're like family, really.

nodes.text: You know, crazy cats aside, I never did get that kiss you promised me.

nodes.text: Uh... Well... The thing about that is...

nodes.text: $Kelly! You look so beautiful in blue. Just like a princess!

nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.text: My little girl... All grown up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice moves, $Kelly!

nodes.text: Nice try!
You take the hit... And level Elliana, who goes crashing to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Way to be tough, $Kelly!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That's it, $Kelly! Just like I taught you!

nodes.text: I can't believe it! I've got a wide-open shot at the goal!

nodes.text: No! Come on!

nodes.text: Another touchdown for Wilson!

nodes.text: 'Here I stand... A delicate English maiden on the cusp of my wedding... So full of passion and ennui that I want to...'

nodes.text: `'Explode!'`

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Bravo! Bravo! This was truly a magnificent performance! Never have I seen a student play so tastefully or elegantly realized!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: 'And now... A sword fight!'

nodes.speaker: BOLTAR
nodes.text: WHY FIGHT? MUST WE PERPETUATE THIS ENDLESS CYCLE OF VIOLENCE? CAN'T WE TALK THIS OUT?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, Boltar, no! This is no time to develop a conscience!
The Wilson Robot winds up and demolishes the Centerscore robot with a devastating punch!

nodes.text: Nooooo!

nodes.text: 'A pocket of pennies, a heartful of dread...'

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Amazing! Great work! This is the best student band I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Centerscore wins!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If only we hadn't lost our plays... I'm sure we could've pulled this off...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're doomed! Doomed!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls! Girls! This is no time for bickering among ourselves!
Everyone goes silent as Taylor walks to the front of the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, I know we haven't had the best season this year. We all made mistakes. We all know ways in which we can improve.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But right now, we have a chance at something so much more important. Right now, we have a chance to turn it all around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This isn't just another game. This isn't even a `big` game. This is the biggest game we will play in the next four years... And I think we've got a great shot at winning it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So let's get out there, and let's show Wilson High and their stupid ringer exactly what we're made of! Are you with me, girls?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We are!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then let's go out there and win this thing!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Is Centerscore High, breaking Wilson's four-year streak! Congratulations, Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And now, accepting the award is Centerscore student Ben Kale!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Judge! Guys, this was an amazing day for Centerscore. It's been a long, tough road getting here. We've had a lot of setbacks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But today, we made it all worth it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In particular, I want to throw a shoutout to the Centerscore track and girls' soccer teams. It was clutch, real clutch, and you won it for us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What else can I say? Whoo! Go Centerscore! After-party at my place!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Is Wilson High for the fifth consecutive Battle of the Schools in a row!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Congratulations, Wilson High! And now, will Wilson President Brad Martinet come up and say a few words?

nodes.speaker: Brad
nodes.text: Thanks, Judge, thanks! This is a great day for Wilson High! Wooo! Go Wilson!
